These are final plotting tables for Procrustes alignment, metabolite comparisons, GAM predictions and KEGG pathways. No PCA, GAM or enrichment model is refitted here. The KEGG results were generated with minGSSize = 10; bubble size represents Count.

Open this file in RStudio and click **Knit**, or run `rmarkdown::render("fig5/fig5.Rmd")` from the repository root. Tables are read from `data/`; PDF and PNG files are written to `plots/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=TRUE, error=FALSE,
                      fig.width=10, fig.height=6, out.width="100%", dpi=120)
dir.create("plots", showWarnings=FALSE)
```

## Input files

```{r inputs, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(data.frame(File=list.files("data")), col.names="File")
```


## Plot settings

```{r figure5-section1}
suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE","English_United States.utf8"))
suppressWarnings(Sys.setlocale("LC_COLLATE","English_United States.utf8"))
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
read_data <- function(name) read.csv(file.path("data",name),check.names=FALSE,encoding="UTF-8")
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size=8,base_family="Arial") +
  theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),panel.border=element_rect(colour="black",fill=NA,linewidth=.7),
        legend.position="bottom",strip.background=element_rect(fill="grey94",linewidth=.3)))
save_plot <- function(p,name,width,height) {
  dir.create("plots",showWarnings=FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path("plots",paste0(name,".pdf")),p,device=cairo_pdf,width=width,height=height,units="mm",limitsize=FALSE)
  ggsave(file.path("plots",paste0(name,".png")),p,device=ragg::agg_png,width=width,height=height,units="mm",dpi=300,limitsize=FALSE)
}
```


## A–B. Procrustes alignment and metabolite differences

```{r figure5-section2}
a<-read_data("procrustes_coordinates.csv");s<-read_data("procrustes_statistics.csv")
p_a<-ggplot(a)+
 geom_segment(aes(x=Metabolome_PC1,y=Metabolome_PC2,xend=Microbiome_PC1,yend=Microbiome_PC2),colour="grey80",linewidth=.25)+
 geom_point(aes(Metabolome_PC1,Metabolome_PC2,shape="Metabolome"),colour="#DFB99B",fill="white",size=1.7,stroke=.35)+
 geom_point(aes(Microbiome_PC1,Microbiome_PC2,shape="Microbiome"),colour="#8FA7BB",fill="#CAD9E5",size=1.8,stroke=.35)+
 scale_shape_manual(values=c(Metabolome=23,Microbiome=24))+labs(title="(A) Procrustes analysis",
 subtitle=sprintf("r = %.3f; PROTEST P = %.4f; n = %d",s$Procrustes_r,s$PROTEST_P,s$N),x="PC 1",y="PC 2",shape=NULL)
b<-read_data("differential_metabolites.csv");b<-b[order(b$Log2FC),];b$Metabolite<-factor(b$Metabolite,levels=b$Metabolite)
label_colours<-ifelse(b$Highlighted,"#D62728","black")
p_b<-ggplot(b,aes(Log2FC,Metabolite))+geom_col(fill="steelblue",width=.8)+
 geom_vline(xintercept=0,colour="grey40",linewidth=.25)+
 geom_text(aes(x=Log2FC+ifelse(Log2FC>=0,.12,-.12),label=Stars),size=2.5)+
 scale_y_discrete()+scale_x_continuous(expand=expansion(mult=.12),breaks=scales::breaks_pretty(5))+
 labs(title="(B) Fecal metabolite differences",x=expression(log[2]*" fold change"),y=NULL)+
 theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=6,colour=label_colours),axis.ticks.y=element_blank())
save_plot(p_a,"figure5A",140,110)
save_plot(p_b,"figure5B",180,145)
```


```{r figure5-preview2, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(c("plots/figure5A.png", "plots/figure5B.png"))
```


## C. GAM predictions

```{r figure5-section3}
d<-read_data("gam_predictions.csv");d$Metabolite<-factor(d$Metabolite,levels=unique(d$Metabolite));d$Group<-factor(d$Group,levels=c("w/o","w/"))
p_c<-ggplot(d,aes(Time,Fit,colour=Group))+geom_line(linewidth=.5)+
 facet_wrap(~Metabolite,nrow=1,scales="free_y",labeller=as_labeller(function(x) vapply(x,function(y) paste(strwrap(gsub("-","- ",gsub(",",", ",y)),width=23),collapse="\n"),character(1))))+
 scale_colour_manual(values=c("w/o"="#F8766D","w/"="#00BFC4"))+
 scale_x_continuous(breaks=0:3,limits=c(0,3))+
 labs(title="(C) GAM model predictions for differential metabolites",x=NULL,y="Standardized abundance",colour="Group")+
 theme(strip.text=element_text(size=5.5),axis.text=element_text(size=6),legend.position="right")
save_plot(p_c,"figure5C",300,80)
```


```{r figure5-preview3, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(c("plots/figure5C.png"))
```


## D–E. KEGG pathways and figure assembly

```{r figure5-section4}
k<-read_data("kegg_pathways.csv")
k$Group<-factor(k$Group,levels=c("w/o","w/"))
make_kegg<-function(module){
 d<-k[k$Module==module,];d$Description<-factor(d$Description,levels=sort(unique(d$Description)))
 ggplot(d,aes(Group,Description,colour=p.adjust,size=Count))+geom_point()+
 scale_colour_gradient(low="#EF767B",high="#BFBBBA")+
 scale_size_continuous(range=c(1,4))+
 scale_x_discrete(drop=FALSE)+labs(title=module,x=NULL,y=NULL,colour="p.adjust",size="Count")+
 theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=6),axis.text.x=element_text(size=7),legend.position="right",
       legend.text=element_text(size=6),legend.title=element_text(size=7),plot.title=element_text(size=9),
       legend.key.height=grid::unit(3,"mm"),legend.key.width=grid::unit(3,"mm"))
}
p_d<-wrap_plots(lapply(paste0("BM",1:4),make_kegg),ncol=2)+plot_annotation(title="(D) Bacterial CAM-associated pathways")
p_e<-wrap_plots(lapply(paste0("FM",1:4),make_kegg),ncol=2)+plot_annotation(title="(E) Fungal CAM-associated pathways")
save_plot(p_d,"figure5D",300,220)
save_plot(p_e,"figure5E",300,185)
for(mod in unique(k$Module)) save_plot(make_kegg(mod),paste0("figure5_",mod),155,max(75,7*length(unique(k$Description[k$Module==mod]))))
# Plot-only assembly; no model fitting or enrichment is performed by this package.
top<-p_a+p_b+plot_layout(widths=c(1,1.3))
p_all<-wrap_plots(top,p_c,wrap_elements(full=p_d),wrap_elements(full=p_e),ncol=1,heights=c(1.2,.7,2,1.6))
save_plot(p_all,"figure5",310,490)
```


```{r figure5-preview4, echo=FALSE}
knitr::include_graphics(c("plots/figure5D.png", "plots/figure5E.png", "plots/figure5.png"))
```
